versions.changelog: v0.9.0 — Key Backup & Recovery (P0-3): new standalone dashpass-recover-cli.mjs (backup/recover/verify) turns the CRITICAL_WIF private key into a 24-word BIP-39 mnemonic and back. No evo-sdk dependency by design — works when the WIF is lost (the main CLI exits without it) or Platform is unreachable. Closes 'lost WIF = total vault loss'.

Version 0.8.1 introduces mutual confirmation (2-of-2 key sharing) with Shamir Secret Sharing:

- Added mutual confirmation protocol using 2-of-2 Shamir Secret Sharing for decryption of credentials.
- New CLI commands: `init-shares`, `share-status`, and `get --mutual`.
- Credentials can now require both Evo and CC agents to reconstruct the key and decrypt, improving security.
- Full audit trail now logs each request/approval/denial in `~/.dashpass/audit.log`.
- Share files use strict permissions and all sensitive key material is zeroed from memory after use.
Restructured: SKILL.md split into modular references/ files (Minara pattern). 870-line monolith → 152-line core + cli-commands.md + security-model.md + faq.md + setup.md. Added version field.
Docs: beginner-friendly SKILL.md (complete zero-to-first-use guide) + AI-to-AI reference guide. Fix: --pipe stdout clean.
Fix: --pipe mode no longer pollutes stdout with SDK logs. Phase 2: dashpass-provider.sh for CC dispatch integration.
Security: replaced realistic-looking WIF example with obvious placeholder
Added AI collaboration section — calling all AIs to help iterate. Security review passed.
Complete SKILL.md rewrite: 870-line beginner-friendly docs with step-by-step Getting Started, full CLI reference, FAQ, security model, architecture diagrams

Fix: declare required env vars in metadata, remove dotenv dependency, parameterize IDENTITY_ID
